qualification.details: Sr. Consultant - Procurement & Contract Management: Masters' Degree/ PG Diploma in Finance/ Procurement/ Supply Chain Management from recognized university/ institution OR Professional qualification of CA/ ICWA. Post qualification total work experience of minimum 05 years in managing procurement and contract management. Out of the total 05 years, the applicant must have experience of working at Senior Position for at least 02 years in public sector procurement or in Govt. Medical Supplies Corporations or in NHM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Health Mission Uttarakhand (NHM Uttarakhand) for filling up contractual healthcare sector positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Sr. Consultant - Procurement & Contract Management under advertisement number 3196/NHMUK/HR/2026-27/E-149729(371-C).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Sr. Consultant?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sr. Consultant - Procurement & Contract Management post in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form via Indian Speed Post or Registered Post is 18 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Masters' Degree or PG Diploma in Finance, Procurement, or Supply Chain Management, or hold professional qualifications like CA or ICWA along with required experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any prior experience required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants require a minimum of 05 years of post-qualification total work experience in procurement and contract management, including senior position experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit and cutoff date for the Sr. Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 42 years as calculated on 01 January 2026, with age relaxations applicable for experienced NHM working candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Sr. Consultant - Procurement & Contract Management position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 90,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode by sending hard copies of documents and application forms through Indian Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application details directly from the official website at www.nhm.uk.gov.in or via the links provided above.
